title: @tool doesn't first instantiate @exported variables
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in Godot v4.6.beta3

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta3 - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 19 Sep 2025 16:09:36 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) HD Graphics 4600 (HSW GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4700HQ CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.49 GiB memory

### Issue description

if you have `@tool` and exported `set(value):` variable in the set there's not exported variables yet they are all null

IF I comment out `@tool` it works fine

### Steps to reproduce

```python
@tool # coment this line out and it'll work fine
extends Node3D
class_name ToolTest

@export var csg_box_3d: CSGBox3D
@onready var csg_box_3d1: CSGBox3D = $CSGBox3D

@export var size: float:
	set(value):
		csg_box_3d.size.x = value # it's null if it's tool
		csg_box_3d1.size.x = value # it's null if it's tool
		size = value
```

1. make a scene with tool in it and child that it changes
2. make another scene with 1. scene and try to play it IF you try to run 1. scene it works ok.
3. comment out `@tool` and another scene with tools in it will work fine

[testing_tool_2026-01-13_09-20-19.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24583759/testing_tool_2026-01-13_09-20-19.zip)

play map and play around with `@tool`
